title: Complete coupled-output caller: conditional κ = 0.003027288235 (+5e-12 over #5400)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This completes #5402's coupled-output interface without assuming its eight original modes start blank. The new local word preserves all 632 arbitrary original inputs, accepts 17 arbitrary owned fields and returns them to zero, and produces 408 independent positive Gaussian helpers alongside the standard 224 main outputs. Eight explicitly paid rank-8 jobs restore the coupled modes.

The conditional certificate is **κ = 0.003027288235**, tested at **0.003027288245**: exactly **5 × 10⁻¹²** above the independently checked #5398/#5400 point 0.00302728823. **Recursive economic gain is zero:** 144 added paid H8 jobs and 144 added productive H8 targets cancel rankwise for every exponent. This gain is funded compiler headroom. The selected κ remains 0.0030217758 under the same five native/all-column, ownership, compiler, precision/tape and analytic-recovery assumptions. No unconditional theorem, formal-kernel acceptance or κ-maximality is claimed.

The final implementation joins the raw register-ID/macro packet with an explicit common 145-axis normalizer plan. Execution is RIGHT boundary → chronological physical events → LEFT boundary, with all 10928 canonical targets and every actual register ID joined. All 30368 added normalizer field maps are charged ordinary work, including IDLE routes and 1792 native central translations. The raw private allocation is 306 local fields plus one shared 112-field query bank. Complete invoice: **64260 paid calls /10928 productive fields**; scalar tariff **3634556** in the retained tariff unit, with fresh separate tape/control/recursive-storage majorants.

Price-plane scope: #5409's upper exclusion U=0.00302728825 concerns the fixed controller/profile family. Exact H8 neutrality leaves its signed moment unchanged. K/U=605457647/605457650 and U−K=15×10⁻¹². This is not a universal packing optimum or a changed raw ceiling.

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor assignment; task `joint-query-controller`, scope **changed** from the historical QQ16 card to this frozen coupled-output consumer and complete admission. Canonical base `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority7. This adds a concrete all-original caller and fresh source-specialized funding. The promoted 120-owner decoder remains open and is not an input.

Exact source heads: #5402 `3348fccea855082786d5f0fc5558b73d4974e745`; #5398 `174fb211493b43a42210434083e9702b4fb7a2ce`; #5400 `7ea72fb692cbfd64fea556de84327bbf88555986`; #5407 `b62252c61113d2863b36ce2419aa81a07f393c42`. Portable raw Git origins preserve exact source membership without asserting pending side heads are publication ancestors. Related #5408/#5409/#5411/#5412 and the released promoted 120 handoff were checked for overlap. The 01:54 UTC refresh found unchanged dependency heads and no competing completed caller.

## Validation

Publication commit `0c1fa2f47fb5ea17b93a4b67063d08e49cc38e51`. Python3.12/standard library only.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-helper-neutral-completion
```

- All 649 local B/F columns and 11 rejected mutants; current 400-helper adapters independently checked with absolute phase.
- All 32 global Laurent rows and all canonical main/helper/IDLE routes with 8 global controls; register-ID join with 3 further controls.
- Fresh directed-rational endpoint, funded reserve/tails/height, ordinary BIT stock and all 54 strict plus 4 functional outer predicates. The preceding height-grid failure is a height test, not a next-κ or maximal-κ claim.
- Corrected ordinary census, fresh expanded precision/simultaneous-stock/source-application proof, and all 25 aggregate premises PASS. Aggregate SHA256 `2172779f65f16b073a25e393bb0ac9cc320135360ad57c6f576917cda1ffd106`. Earlier order/Q-exponent diagnostics and original scoped false flags remain unchanged.
- Exact committed registered normal/optimized replay PASS (28.008 s), all stable mathematical fields reproduced, scientific assertions retained even in direct file imports. Committed-byte and canonical-source-history checks PASS. Official 144-file export PASS; read-only Git-free normal (13.784 s)/optimized (13.684 s) PASS, files 0444/0555. No empty-PATH test is claimed. Hosted CI [passed](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40052821077) at this exact head: both planning and bounded replay succeeded, including the committed-inputs check.

The unchanged #5402 provider acceptance is authenticated reuse of #5407. No duplicate full native/1240-phase replay, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run. Written all-width and source-application proofs remain distinct from finite executable checks and independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

A fully paid joint decoder for the retained-cache 120-owner triangular program is the next target. Its positive-v block is Gaussian, while its negative code and original-input contamination remain explicit. Prove one all-input correction using actual observations, zero returns and the complete bill. The missing decoder prevents crediting larger optimistic margins. See the package README and TASK.json for the smallest follow-up and blocker.

### Scientific handoff

**Research discussion / PR / artifact:** Completed neutral coupled-output caller and its conditional source-bound validation, #5413; next research is the separate promoted 120-owner joint decoder.

**Exact commit:** `0c1fa2f47fb5ea17b93a4b67063d08e49cc38e51`. The frozen aggregate is `2172779f65f16b073a25e393bb0ac9cc320135360ad57c6f576917cda1ffd106`.

**What is established:** The complete caller, all 25 source-application gates, local/global/invoice/precision checks, committed normal/optimized and read-only Git-free replays, and hosted CI pass. Conditional κ=.003027288235 gains 5e-12 over #5400; the five assumptions and selected record remain unchanged. Recursive economic gain is zero.

**What remains uncertain:** A larger price-plane gain needs a different complete signed profile. The 120-owner triangular candidate still has negative-bank code and original-input contamination; no complete joint decoder or larger κ is admitted.

**Smallest useful next task:** Construct one chronological, fully paid correction using retained observations; test every original column and owned zero return. Stop if it spoils a previously Gaussian block, assumes a free tail, or exceeds the fully charged margin. No exclusive follow-up claim is asserted here.

**Reproduction command and expected runtime:** `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-helper-neutral-completion`; observed registered pair about 28 s, direct normal/optimized wrappers about 14 s each. These are measured verification times, not a physical tape benchmark.

**Predecessor credit:** Dillon's #5402 provider; Ali Romman's cached-center/direct-caller work; Chris R's independent source-phase/review lineage; all retained native, controller, scalar, compiler, BIT and analytic contributors and notices. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
